svg.title: Ibn Battuta: Marinid eight-pointed star
svg.desc: Period motif. An eight-pointed geometric star from the decorative vocabulary of Marinid Morocco, rather than the modern five-pointed Moroccan star. Marinid objects document the motif; the frequently reproduced red-and-gold dynastic flag should not be treated as securely attested by those objects. Colors follow the game palette, with darker banner ink where needed for contrast; not historical flag colors.
